title: Smoking Doorway
description: A dark, surreal nighttime scene featuring an open blue door on a weathered building with a glowing pink interior light. A severed, pale arm protrudes from the bottom of the doorway, exhaling thick purple smoke that swirls into colorful, serpentine ribbons across the ground.
prompt: A dark surreal night scene of an old building with a glowing open blue door revealing a pink interior. A severed pale human arm sticks out from the bottom of the doorway, exhaling thick purple smoke that swirls into colorful glowing ribbons across the asphalt. Parked cars and trucks are visible in the background under a twilight sky, dramatic painterly brushstrokes, moody and unsettling atmosphere.
